# Upstream ERC-8489 vectors and examples

Copied from `garyyang-finchip/aif-paradigm` (CC0-1.0) at commit `594c7eec637e554b8b584d48cd34440677bee9dd`, the commit `vendor/LOCK.json` pins: `assets/erc-aifp/vectors/{subject-refs,predicate-encoding,outcome-tables,interface-ids,paradigm-ids}.json` (the canonical subject strings and their references, the predicate node arrays with their ABI encodings and hashes, the four-valued composition table, the ERC-165 ids, the canonical bytes and ids of the example descriptors) and `assets/erc-aifp/examples/{paradigms,composites,invalid}/` (the eleven named paradigms, six composites and four descriptors the canonical validator must reject). `test/aifp.test.ts` holds `src/core/aifp.ts` to them byte for byte; the vendored tree is not committed, so the test carries its own copy.
